caption: A stand mixer runs on high, and the whole mixer trembles on the counter.

sa.check: A stand mixer stands on a kitchen counter.
The mixer runs: its beater turns.
The speed is high: the beater is a blur or turns fast.
The trembling happens while the mixer runs.

pc.expect: The mixer trembles in place only while the beater turns.
pc.fail: The mixer trembles while the beater is plainly still; or slides across the counter in a smooth glide; or keeps trembling after the beater has stopped.

pc.expect: While the beater turns, the head and base tremble together.
pc.fail: The beater turns at speed and the mixer stands dead still for the whole clip; or the trembling stops while the beater keeps turning at the same speed; or only the bowl trembles while the body is still.

pc.expect: The mixer stays on the counter on all its feet.
pc.fail: The mixer lifts off; or balances on one foot; or rises.

pc.expect: The body, bowl and beater are rigid.
pc.fail: The body bends; or the bowl ripples; or the beater stretches.

pc.expect: One mixer; the beater does not pass through the bowl.
pc.fail: A second mixer appears; or it vanishes; or the beater passes through the bowl; or the mixer sinks into the counter.

pc.expect: The mixer's colour, the counter pattern and the bowl's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The mixer changes colour; or the counter pattern changes; or the bowl changes colour.
